description: This file declares functions and structures related to launching and managing text editors within a Git environment. It provides interfaces for opening editors, editing buffers, and determining terminal properties, specifically tailored for Git's internal use.

methods.name: git_editor
methods.description: Returns the preferred editor command as a string.

methods.name: git_sequence_editor
methods.description: Returns the sequence editor command as a string.

methods.name: is_terminal_dumb
methods.description: Checks if the terminal is a 'dumb' terminal.

methods.name: launch_editor
methods.description: Launches the user's preferred editor to edit a specified file; fills a buffer with the file's contents if provided.

methods.name: launch_sequence_editor
methods.description: Launches the sequence editor to edit a file; similar to launch_editor.

methods.name: strbuf_edit_interactively
methods.description: Writes out a buffer to a file, launches an editor, then reads the file back into the buffer, cleaning up afterwards.
